author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.13.0 — Fixes a real mis-crediting bug: a room-clean run that returns to charge because the battery got critically low (not because the room actually finished) was being treated as a genuine finish, wrongly crediting the room as done and locking in a too-short time estimate. Now detected via the battery level at the transition and left 'active' (excluded from re-picking, not credited) with elapsed time carried forward, resolving itself once the vacuum resumes and finishes for real -- or force-finished after 3+ hours parked with no resume, so nothing gets stuck.
